title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin closed the US session at $62,454, down 1.7 percent as extreme fear gripped the market with the index at 22. Hashrate held strong at 923.8 EH/s while the mempool backed up to 91,687 transactions, keeping the fastest fee at just 2 sat/vB. Block 957,938 confirmed without disruption. Key takeaway: price weakness met resilient network fundamentals and suppressed fees. Overnight, monitor for any sentiment shift or volume pickup ahead of Asian open.
